summary: Iter 278 Expenses Tracker - frontend + backend verification. Backend pytest (tests/test_iter278_expenses.py) passes 3/3 (verified earlier by main agent). Frontend: ALL data-testids exist on /svc/engineer/expenses (engineer-expenses, stat strip, action buttons, filters) and on Service Desk Insights -> Expenses (desk-expenses, all 3 sub-tabs, KPIs, reports table/group chips/export, settings rules + categories). Engineer manual expense form opens correctly with all named fields. However, two real issues were found: (1) the qa-expenses QuickAction is NOT present on the engineer home for the indie engineer (indie.engineer@gymaxisai.com lands on /partner-engineer, not on EngineerHomeV2 where qa-expenses was added) — engineers must currently deep-link to /svc/engineer/expenses; (2) after submitting a MANUAL expense via exp-submit as the solo engineer, the list still shows the empty state ('No expenses yet. Scan a receipt to get started.') and zero exp-row-* rows render — the create call or the list refresh after submit appears broken on the engineer page. The receipt OCR flow couldn't be fully exercised because subsequent buttons (exp-action-mileage / exp-action-scan) became unreachable after the manual form path (no clean close).
